method: Factual snapshot from official web reads of the named Topps Ripped articles; this file's SHA-256 verifies the retained observation, not raw page HTML.

observations.heading: Rookie Premiere Patch Autographs
observations.qualification: The guide calls this named program one-of-one; the checklist prints ROOKIE PREM1ERE PATCH AUTOGRAPHS. This does not number the separate TOPPS CHROME ROOKIE PATCH AUTOGRAPHS program.

observations.heading: Collector FAQs / Are there rookie patch autographs

remainingGaps: The Spotlight's Hobby Box section says one autograph per box; its FAQ and Key Facts instead say one per pack. Do not select or convert either claim into odds.
These articles do not establish the complete numbered parallel ladder for the 400-card base program, its distinct veteran and rookie families, inserts or autographs.
No card-specific colored-autograph examples or regular Chrome limits are assigned to unrelated families or to Sapphire.
